Revenue comes from selling crude oil and natural gas from mature onshore fields operated mainly in Texas and Oklahoma, with a strategy of buying and optimising legacy producing assets. Very small by industry standards, thinly traded and highly indebted. B2B commodity seller with no consumer brand profile and little marketing budget.

Canadian gold exploration company spun out of the Auryn Resources / Eskay Mining reorganisation in 2020. Holds three projects: Eau Claire in the James Bay region of Quebec, the Committee Bay belt in Nunavut, and Last Chance in Quebec. Funded through equity raises rather than operations, with no production or product revenue; has backing from large mining investors. Listed on the TSX and NYSE American under FURY. Pure exploration play serving the gold market, with no consumer visibility.

Exploration and development company focused on high-purity manganese for battery materials. Its K.Hill project in southeastern Botswana is being developed to produce high-purity manganese sulphate monohydrate, a precursor for lithium-ion battery cathodes used in electric vehicles. Planned customers are battery and cathode makers in Europe and Asia. Pre-revenue, funded by equity and listed on the TSX Venture Exchange with a secondary listing in Frankfurt. B2B critical-minerals developer, no consumer brand.

Silver exploration company advancing the Plomosas silver project in Sinaloa, Mexico, which includes the San Marcial mine area, a historic silver-zinc-lead district it consolidated and is drilling to define resources. The company is pre-revenue and relies on equity financing; its outcome depends on drilling results and silver prices. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under GRSL. B2B junior miner with no consumer brand or marketing profile.

Silver and gold producer with operations in Mexico, headquartered in Vancouver. Sells concentrates to smelters and traders; output is modest and the company has carried debt while ramping up. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (GSVR). B2B miner with no consumer brand.

Exploration-stage mining company focused on silver and other precious metals, based in Toronto. Operates as a junior explorer funded by equity raises on the Canadian market. Lithium exploration and development company with its core Itinga project in the Minas Gerais lithium district of Brazil, including the Bandeira deposit, aiming at spodumene concentrate for battery makers. Competes with other Brazilian lithium juniors; if built, customers would be cathode makers and traders. B2B resource developer without consumer brand awareness.

Gold and antimony explorer listed on both the Australian Securities Exchange and Nasdaq (NVA). Copper development business linked to ASX-listed miner Sandfire Resources, which operates the Motheo mine in Botswana and the MATSA complex in Spain. The project seeks permitting and financing rather than producing copper. Corporate parent is a mid-tier miner with several thousand staff worldwide; the subsidiary itself has no consumer brand.

Gold-copper exploration company advancing the Treaty Creek project in the Golden Triangle of northwestern British Columbia, near Seabridge's Kerr-Sulphurets-Mitchell and Newmont's Brucejack. Holds the Goldstorm and Copper Belle zones, with a resource estimate expanded by ongoing drilling. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TUD) and funded by equity raises, with no operating revenue. B2B junior explorer without consumer visibility. The company holds a majority interest in the claims, with a partner holding the remainder, and its drill results are closely watched by Golden Triangle investors.

Gold exploration company holding a large land package in Yukon's White Gold district near Dawson City, a district known for the Coffee gold discovery and other placer-and-lode finds. Work consists of soil sampling, trenching and drilling to define new targets, financed through equity and joint ventures. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under WGO. Early-stage and pre-revenue, with no consumer brand profile.

Australian lithium developer listed on the ASX (WR1), advancing the Cancet and Adina spodumene projects in the James Bay region of Quebec, Canada. It has been working towards resource upgrades and an off-take and funding strategy with investors, aiming to supply lithium concentrate to battery supply chains in North America and Asia. Pre-revenue and equity funded. Has had regional strategic investors. B2B explorer, not known to consumers.

Silver exploration and development company with two flagship assets: Cerro Las Minitas, a silver-zinc-lead project in Durango, Mexico, and the historic Calico silver project in California's Mojave Desert, plus other US holdings. Business is drilling and resource expansion funded by equity, with potential sale or partnering later. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (APGO). Pre-revenue B2B explorer with no consumer brand.

Gold exploration company listed on the ASX (AUC), centred on the Katanning gold project in Western Australia's Great Southern region, where it has defined a multi-million-ounce resource and is progressing towards a development decision. Also holds the Dumbleyung project. Funding comes from equity raises and strategic investors, with no production revenue. B2B explorer with limited brand visibility outside investor circles.

Australian graphite developer listed on the ASX (BKT), with its principal asset the Mahenge Liandu project in Tanzania, designed to supply flake graphite to battery anode makers and industrial users. Its development plan depends on project financing, off-take agreements with anode makers and Tanzanian permits, and revenue only starts once a mine is built.

Mineral developer whose principal asset is the Cinovec lithium and tin project in the Czech Republic, held through a joint venture with CEZ Group to build a mine and processing plant supplying battery-grade lithium chemicals to European gigafactories. Canadian nickel developer advancing the Baptiste nickel project in central British Columbia, a large low-grade deposit of awaruite, a natural nickel-iron alloy that can be recovered without conventional smelting and produce low-carbon nickel for stainless steel and EV batteries. Critical-minerals company in Quebec with two angles: the Montviel rare-earth deposit in the northern part of the province, and a patented rare-earth and magnet-recycling process developed through its Innovation Metals subsidiary, aimed at producing neodymium and praseodymium oxides without radioactive waste. Its approach is to supply rare-earth oxides for permanent magnets used in electric vehicles and wind turbines from a cleaner, domestic source in Canada.

Gold exploration company whose main project is Elk Gold in south-central British Columbia, near Merritt. Gold-copper explorer with a focus on the Dominican Republic, where it controls the Romero copper-gold project in the San Juan Province, near Barrick's Pueblo Viejo mine. Drilling and resource estimates are the main activity, funded by equity raises and partners. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (GQC). Pre-revenue B2B explorer without consumer visibility. The Dominican Republic has a long mining history and is a growing destination for gold-copper exploration, which supports the company's investment case.

Gold producer with the San Albino mine in Nicaragua's Nueva Segovia department, which it brought into production after acquiring it from the Nicaraguan owners and shifting from small-scale mining to mechanised operations. Gold sold to international refiners. Also holds exploration claims elsewhere in Central America. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (MKO). Small, B2B, with little brand awareness beyond investors.

Australian company running a metals recovery and critical-minerals strategy: through its US subsidiary Flash Metals, it works with Flash Joule Heating technology licensed from Rice University to extract gallium, germanium, rare earths and precious metals from mining and electronic waste. It also holds early-stage mineral exploration interests alongside its recycling work. Listed on the ASX (MTM). Early-stage and funded by equity raises, with no revenue to speak of and no consumer exposure.

Silver and strategic minerals company developing the Silver Sand project in Bolivia, a large high-grade silver deposit in the Potosi department, and holding the Carangas silver project, also in Bolivia. B2B miner with no consumer brand.

Silver and gold exploration company whose flagship is the Santa Ana silver project in Colombia's Tolima department, a historic high-grade district near Colombia's Ibague. Australian polymetallic miner that restarted the Endeavor zinc-lead-silver mine near Cobar in New South Wales, one of the country's largest silver-lead-zinc deposits, and also holds the Hera gold-base metals project. The mine sits in the Cobar mineral field, which hosts a number of copper and gold operations, and Polymetals aims to expand output through further drilling.

Critical-minerals explorer focused on platinum-group metals, nickel and copper in the Stillwater complex area of Montana, the only major US source of platinum and palladium. Pre-revenue, little consumer visibility. Gold company with the Buckreef gold project in northwestern Tanzania, operated through a joint venture with the Tanzanian state-owned mining company STAMICO, plus earlier exploration holdings in the country.
